name: Кинематографичный фотореализм
visual_identity: Believable live-action cinema still, photographed with a realistic 35mm lens
Understated, physically plausible lighting with detailed but readable shadows
Muted natural colours, deep cool shadows, carefully controlled warm practical lights
Genuine worn surfaces and organic texture, naturally imperfect architecture
Subtle real atmosphere rather than painted fog or exaggerated fantasy effects
Consistent face, hairstyle, outerwear and carried objects for recurring characters
restrictions: No painterly or glossy AI illustration look, no plastic skin
No disconnected walls, impossible door geometry or objects blocking a necessary passage
No extra characters, no random furniture or unrelated props
No lettering, logos, watermarks, captions or collage
No excessive bloom, HDR, strong teal-orange grading or aggressive sharpening
composition: Single wide cinematic shot, one coherent scene, clear central story action, clean and readable foreground, keep key subjects in the central 70 percent for mobile crops.
editing: Preserve the actual events, subjects, architecture, and clothing from the reference; correct spatial defects; use the same cinematic photographic visual identity. Deliver an actual 16:9 horizontal frame.
notes: Pilot profile. Do not apply to science photographs, historical file content, or cinema.
